claims.statement: Pardue Cloudflare RFC 9530 Digest Fields Abstract This document defines HTTP fields that support integrity digests.

evidence.excerpt: Pardue Cloudflare RFC 9530 Digest Fields Abstract This document defines HTTP fields that support integrity digests.

claims.statement: The Content-Digest field can be used for the integrity of HTTP message content.

evidence.excerpt: The Content-Digest field can be used for the integrity of HTTP message content.

claims.statement: The Repr-Digest field can be used for the integrity of HTTP representations.

evidence.excerpt: The Repr-Digest field can be used for the integrity of HTTP representations.

claims.statement: Want-Content-Digest and Want-Repr-Digest can be used to indicate a sender's interest and preferences for receiving the respective Integrity fields.

evidence.excerpt: Want-Content-Digest and Want-Repr-Digest can be used to indicate a sender's interest and preferences for receiving the respective Integrity fields.
